mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memberships (user_id, workspace_id, role) VALUES (#{userId}, #{workspaceId}, #{role}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, workspace_id) DO UPDATE SET role = EXCLUDED.role
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM memberships WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
